title: 第十一回 拜师九蝉第十二回 拜师取经
slug: 驭音心经第七十回狼心逞乱
lines: 第十一回拜师九蝉
“我是被他们抓进来的。”
扫地僧微微一笑，视眼前变故如茶叙，仿佛他身处不是牢房里，而是置身茂竹青翠的竹房里，与远道而来暇访的挚友茶叙，神若风清，心若云逸。
“被抓进来的？”
鹤雁闻言，满心讶异。
以他的判断，这个扫地僧身一身灵修与仙力，隐没于灵云寺，已是让人匪夷所思：“他怎么会被抓起来呢？”
“鼠怪抓他干什么呢？”
“此中必有古怪！”
扫地僧看他一眼，淡淡一笑：“怎么，想不通吧。”
“哈哈，想不通就对啦，不过，听我一讲，我想你就明白了。”
原来，这事说起来玄妙蹊跷，但若从源头说起，却也是两人有缘，才有今日得见。
正如孤鹤雁所揣测的那样，这扫地僧的来头确实非同一般，他原是天书文院的典书舍令，名号九蝉。
这典书舍令是干什么的呢，乍一听，貌似天廷的高级官员，然而事实并非如此。
这官职虽然听起来甚是光彩好听，但其内里，却与孙悟空昔日在天庭担任的弼马温一职颇为相似，官位末流，微不足道。
九蝉的日常，就是埋首堆积如山的典籍书藏，整理归纳，分门别类，终日与文书为伴，实与官宦无关。
九蝉个性率真，谈吐真性，喜欢开心剖腹的畅谈，但在泛仙的天廷，他这份畅谈与率真难免不是一种为尊自大，唐突冒犯。
因此，在天廷，他过得并不开心，亦很难有知心共鸣的朋友。
九蝉喜欢阅读，探究灵修，但天书文院的那些书，大多是些经文、规制、条例、典范，读起来了无味道。
在这上不能赴宴交酬，下不能饱书散闷的混日子里，他恰巧认识一个极要好的好朋友。
这个朋友就是已经仙去的灵云寺开寺主持，天文仙君门下的研墨童子，自号：“了文院”
了文院经常来天书文院借书还书，此人甚是个爱书读书之人，但他不同于九蝉，九蝉非常反感天廷的经书典范，但了文院却并不反感，而且甚喜欢研读。
他和九蝉有一个共通点，那就是，二人都喜欢探究灵修，而且，都不喜欢呆在天廷。
且说那一日，了文院又来借书，九蝉正憋得闲闷，于是便驭力发功，将一排竹简盘绕成一条飞龙，在书架间往回穿梭，上下翻舞。
瞥眼看到又是一副醉心自我、书中图乐的了文院，九蝉呵呵一笑，语中略带讥讽：“天天研看，你是要成魔，还是要成仙？”
未想，了文院闻言，只是淡然一笑：“成魔成仙，只在人看，自己得道，才是自然。”
“你这修为，是在练给谁看？”
了文院一句极有禅意的回答，一下震动九蝉，令他心头一颤，正在如魔乱舞的竹龙，瞬时不成体统，摔落一地，纷乱不堪！
自此，九蝉便和了文院就成了天廷最要好的朋友，两人相聊共欢，无话不谈。
然而，这二人形影不离的时候多了，在仙界亦产生很多非议，很多人认为他们之间有着难以言说的秘密。
异样的眼光和话语多了，二人便决定辞作仙人，下凡隐居。
天廷虽给了他们准许，但却罚去二人很多阳寿，下来之时，二人已是花甲之年。
了文院研经甚多，久润文墨，满腹经纶，不希望自己的毕生研修与学识被湮没，于是，便在玉峰山筹建了灵云寺，了文院做了开寺主持，九蝉做了他的助手。
但是九蝉生性不喜约束，自由散漫，醉心山野，就做了一个与众不同的存在，成了灵云寺里喝酒吃肉的花和尚。
晨钟暮鼓，逸世安详，本是一件无忧无虑的事。
可是，了文院只重经文，不重香火，久而久之，寺中的日常琐事与管理，就都落到了胖主持手里，这也给后来的灵云寺祸起，埋下伏笔。
了文院仙寂前，九蝉在了文院的庇护下，地位尊崇，虽是个花和尚，却还是寺里的长老。
然而，了文院一仙寂，九蝉的境遇便急转直下，喝酒吃肉，触犯寺里的清规戒律，大受胖主持排挤，由原来的长老变成了执事，又由执事变成了班首，再由班首变成寺里的炭头、伙头，最后，完全成了一个扫地的！
在寺里众僧人看来，九蝉也并表现出不开心，而是继续的随性散漫，饮酒食肉，不尊戒律。
每日里，能挑水就挑水，能扫地就扫地，做的全凭自己开心。
胖主持也逐渐对他放弃了戒心，任他作为。
然而，寺里人不知道的是，九蝉之所以这么做，背后却是另有原因！
九蝉清晰的记得那一天，那一天，了文院突然找到他，向他公告一个噩耗！

Chapter 11: Become a disciple of Jiu Chan
"I was caught by them."
The sweeping monk smiled slightly and regarded the changes in front of him like a tea chat, as if he was not in a prison cell but in a bamboo house with lush green bamboos, having a tea chat with his best friend who had come from afar to visit him.
"Caught in?"
When He Yan heard this, he was filled with surprise.
Based on his judgment, it was unbelievable that this sweeping monk, possessed of spiritual cultivation and immortal power, was hiding in Lingyun Temple. "How could he be arrested?"
"Why did the rat monster catch him?"
"There must be something weird in this!"
The sweeping monk glanced at him and smiled faintly: "Why, I can't figure it out."
"Haha, you can't figure it out, but if you listen to me, I think you will understand."
It turns out that this matter sounds mysterious and strange, but if we start from the source, it is because the two of them are destined to meet today.
Just as Gu Heyan guessed, the background of this sweeping monk is indeed extraordinary. He was originally the Dian Shushe of Tianshu Academy, and his name was Jiuchichan.
What is the purpose of this Dian Shu She Ling? At first glance, it sounds like a senior official of the Heavenly Court, but this is not the case.
Although this official position sounds very glorious and pleasant, in reality, it is quite similar to the position of Bima Wen that Sun Wukong once held in the heaven. The official position is low-ranking and insignificant.
Jiuchichan's daily life is to bury his head in the mountain of classics, sorting, summarizing and classifying them. He is accompanied by documents all day long and has nothing to do with officials.
Jiu Chan has an outspoken personality and talks sincerely, and he likes to talk openly and cheerfully. However, in the pan-immortal heaven, his outspokenness and outspokenness are inevitably not arrogant and offensive.
Therefore, he did not live happily in Tianting, and it was difficult for him to have close and sympathetic friends.
Jiu Chan likes to read and explore spiritual practices, but most of the books in Tianshu Academy are scriptures, regulations, regulations, and models, which are tasteless to read.
In these days when he couldn't go to dinner parties or socialize, or read books to relax, he happened to meet a very good friend.
This friend is the founder of Lingyun Temple who has passed away. He is a boy who studied ink under the sect of Tianwen Immortal. He calls himself: "Liao Wenyuan"
Liao Wenyuan often came to Tianshu Academy to borrow and return books. He was a book lover, but he was different from Jiu Chan. Jiu Chan was very disgusted with Tianting's scriptures and classics, but Liao Wenyuan was not disgusted with them and liked to study them.
He and Jiu Chan have one thing in common, that is, they both like to explore spiritual practice, and neither of them likes to stay in the Heavenly Court.
Let's talk about that day, after returning to the liberal arts college and borrowing books again, Jiu Chan was feeling bored, so she used her strength to coil a row of bamboo slips into a flying dragon, shuttle back and forth between the bookshelves, and dance up and down.
Glancing at him, he saw another self-obsessed man who was enjoying himself and reading books. Jiu Chan chuckled, with a hint of sarcasm in his words: "Take a look every day, are you going to become a demon or an immortal?"
Without thinking, when Liao Wenyuan heard this, he just smiled indifferently: "Becoming a demon or an immortal is only natural in the eyes of others, and you can achieve the Tao yourself."
"Who are you practicing your cultivation for?"
A very Zen-like answer from the Wenyuan shook Jiuchichan and made his heart tremble. The bamboo dragon that was dancing like a demon suddenly fell out of shape and fell to the ground in a chaotic mess!
From then on, Jiu Chan and Wenyuan became the best friends of Tianting. The two chatted and enjoyed each other and talked about everything.
However, these two people have been inseparable for many times, which has caused a lot of criticism in the fairy world. Many people believe that there is an unspeakable secret between them.
After seeing many strange looks and words, the two of them decided to resign as immortals and live in seclusion in the mortal world.
Although the heavenly court gave them permission, they were punished by depriving them of a lot of life. When they came down, they were already in their sixties.
He studied scriptures a lot in the Wenyuan Academy, and he has been writing and writing for a long time. He is full of economics. He did not want his lifelong study and knowledge to be lost, so he planned to build Lingyun Temple in Yufeng Mountain. He became the presiding officer of the temple in the Wenyuan Academy, and Jiu Chan became his assistant.
However, Jiu Chan does not like restraint by nature, is free and carefree, and loves the mountains and wilderness, so he becomes a unique existence and becomes a flower monk who drinks wine and eats meat in Lingyun Temple.
The bells ring in the morning and the drums ring in the evening, and the world is peaceful and peaceful. This is a carefree thing.
However, the liberal arts academy only focused on scriptures and not on incense. Over time, the daily chores and management of the temple fell into the hands of the fat abbot, which also laid the foundation for the subsequent disaster of Lingyun Temple.
Before the immortal silence of Wenyuan, Jiuchan was under the protection of Wenyuan and had a respected status. Although he was a flower monk, he was still an elder in the temple.
However, after the Academy of Fine Arts became immortal, Jiu Chan's situation took a turn for the worse. She drank and ate meat, violated the temple's rules and regulations, and was greatly ostracized by the fat abbot. She changed from an elder to a deacon, then from a deacon to a class leader, and then from a class leader to a gang leader and gang leader in the temple. Finally, she became a complete sweeper!
In the eyes of the monks in the temple, Jiu Chan did not appear unhappy, but continued to be careless, drinking and eating meat, and disrespecting the precepts.
Every day, if you can carry water, you can carry water, if you can sweep the floor, you can sweep the floor. Whatever you do depends on your own happiness.
The fat host also gradually gave up his guard against him and let him do whatever he wanted.
However, what the people in the temple didn't know was that there was another reason behind Jiuchan's behavior!
Jiu Chan clearly remembered that day. On that day, the Academy of Liberal Arts suddenly found him and announced a bad news to him!
